title: [Tutorial] The VS Code Agents Window: Manage AI Agents Across Workspaces in One Place
author: yecats131
selftext:
https://youtu.be/OigIl7aLUrQ
VS Code has an Agents Window that lets you manage multiple AI sessions across projects in one place. I've been using it to work on my website and my role playing game at the same time. Made a short video walking through the main features. A few things worth knowing:

- When you start a session, you choose between local folder, GitHub repo, or remote, and whether to use a worktree (isolated branch) or the current folder
- There are three approval modes: Default Approvals (prompt for anything significant), Bypass Approvals (approve most things automatically), and Autopilot (hands off)
- The Changes panel shows every file the agent touched with full diffs, and you can right-click any change to ask the agent to explain or review its own work. You can also give it feedback inline and have it make the changes.
